items.title: A randomized trial of levamisole versus placebo as adjuvant therapy in malignant melanoma.
items.journal: Journal of clinical oncology : official journal of the American Society of Clinical Oncology
items.summary: Randomized trial of levamisole versus placebo as adjuvant therapy in malignant melanoma showed no difference in disease-free interval, time to visceral metastasis, or survival after 10.5 years median follow-up.

items.title: DOC-MEK: a double-blind randomized phase II trial of docetaxel with or without selumetinib in wild-type BRAF advanced melanoma.
items.journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
items.summary: Double-blind randomized phase II trial of docetaxel with or without selumetinib in wild-type BRAF advanced melanoma as first-line treatment.

items.title: Favorable clinical responses in subsets of patients from a randomized, multi-institutional melanoma vaccine trial.
items.summary: Phase III randomized double-blind trial of vaccinia melanoma oncolysate (VMO) versus placebo in stage II melanoma showed no significant difference in disease-free and overall survival in first interim analysis.

items.title: Combined vemurafenib and cobimetinib in BRAF-mutated melanoma.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Randomized phase 3 study of vemurafenib plus cobimetinib versus vemurafenib plus placebo in previously untreated BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma patients.

items.title: Multi-institutional, prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase IIb trial of the tumor lysate, particle-loaded, dendritic cell (TLPLDC) vaccine to prevent recurrence in high-risk melanoma patients: A subgroup analysis.
items.summary: Multi-institutional phase IIb trial of tumor lysate, particle-loaded, dendritic cell (TLPLDC) vaccine versus placebo in resected stage III/IV melanoma patients showed improved 24-month disease-free survival in per treatment analysis.

items.title: Ipilimumab: in previously treated patients with advanced melanoma.
items.journal: BioDrugs : clinical immunotherapeutics, biopharmaceuticals and gene therapy
items.summary: Review of ipilimumab efficacy and tolerability in advanced melanoma, focusing on a phase III trial showing significantly longer median overall survival versus gp100 peptide vaccine.

items.title: Global trends in melanoma burden: A comprehensive analysis from the Global Burden of Disease Study, 1990-2021.
items.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
items.summary: Comprehensive analysis of global melanoma burden from 1990-2021 using Global Burden of Disease Study data, analyzing incidence, mortality, and disability-adjusted life years by region, gender, and age.

items.title: Uveal melanoma: From diagnosis to treatment and the science in between.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of uveal melanoma covering diagnosis, treatment, risk factors, molecular changes, and responses to systemic therapy, noting differences from cutaneous melanoma.

items.title: Molecular Markers and Targets in Melanoma.
items.summary: Review of molecular signaling pathways in different types of melanoma, discussing WHO classification based on cumulative sun damage and genetic drivers.

items.title: Evolution of the tumor immune landscape during treatment with tebentafusp, a T cell receptor-CD3 bispecific.
items.summary: Analysis of tumor immune landscape changes during treatment with tebentafusp, a T cell receptor-CD3 bispecific, in metastatic uveal melanoma patients.

items.title: Trends in Melanoma Incidence and Mortality.

canonicalFacts.claim: Melanoma incidence continues to increase annually despite improvements in therapeutics and identification
Uveal melanomas represent 5% of all melanoma diagnoses in the United States with age-adjusted risk of 5 per 1 million population
Thin melanomas as a group are associated with very good prognosis, though a subset may metastasize and cause death
Brain metastases are a common site of metastasis from malignant melanoma and are associated with poor prognosis
Metastatic uveal melanoma is refractory to immune checkpoint inhibitors

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Use sunscreens, hats, and other protective measures to counteract ultraviolet light exposure
Avoid excessive sun exposure as UV radiation acts as a mutagenic risk factor for melanoma development
Children at high risk for melanoma should have at least annual cutaneous examinations

redFlags: Suspicious skin lesions should be surgically removed and submitted for pathologic examination
Brain metastases from melanoma progress rapidly and are resistant to conventional therapies

pipelineDrugs.mechanism: T cell receptor-based CD3 bispecific targeting
